documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Audited Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Half Year And Year Ended 31.03.2026
Revised Financial Statement For The Financial And Half Year Ended 31.03.2026

analysis.summary: Shine Fashions (India) Limited reported robust financial performance for the financial year ended March 31, 2025, with revenue from operations increasing to Rs. 80.45 crores and profit after tax rising to Rs. 6.97 crores. During the year, the Board approved the establishment of the company's first manufacturing unit for interlining products as a backward integration initiative. Additionally, the company raised capital through the preferential issue of convertible warrants and recommended a bonus issue of shares in the proportion of 7:1.

guidance.claim: The management expects to continue delivering strong growth.
guidance.quote: We expect to be able to continue to deliver strong growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The Board of Directors approved the establishment of the Company's first manufacturing unit for interlining products as a backward integration initiative.
capex_expansion.quote: In FY 2024–25, the Board of Directors approved the establishment of the Company’s first manufacturing unit for interlining (technical textile) products—an initiative marking a strategic move towards backward integration.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 0.125 per equity share for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: Your Directors on 06.05.2025, has recommended payment of dividend of 12.50 paisa (Rs. 0.125/-) per equity share of the face value of Rs. 5/- each fully paid up for the Financial Year 2024-25, which is subject to the approvalof the shareholders at the ensuing Annual General Meeting of the Company.

capital_allocation.claim: The company issued 5,60,000 convertible warrants aggregating up to Rs. 11,59,20,000.
capital_allocation.quote: During the Year 2024-25, the Company has issued 5,60,000 warrants, each convertible into, or exchangeable for, 1 (one) fully paid-up equity share of the Company of face value of Rs. 5/- each (“Warrants”) at a price of Rs. 207/- (Rupees Two Hundred and Seven only) each payable in cash (“Warrants Issue Price”), aggregating up to Rs.11,59,20,000/- (Rupees Eleven Crores Fifty-Nine Lakhs Twenty Thousand Only)

capital_allocation.claim: The Company proposes to utilize the proceeds raised from the proposed preferential issue towards meeting the working capital requirements of the Company.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company proposes to utilize the proceeds raised from the proposed preferential issue towards the following objects or any combination thereof as deemed fit by the management of the Company. a. Tomeet the working capital requirements of the Company

risks_headwinds.claim: The company is facing initial teething troubles and slow progress in implementing its new manufacturing project.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, the company is facing initial teething troubles in implementation of the project and the progress is bit slow.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Company is a profit making company, and any inadequate profits for paying managerial remuneration may be due to reasons beyond its control.
risks_headwinds.quote: The Company is a profit making company. Only for the purpose of payment of Managerial Remuneration, the Company may have inadequate profits, which may be due to reasons beyond its control.

management_commitments.claim: The company is committed to utilizing the unspent CSR amount in the forthcoming financial year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is actively engaged in identifying viable projects and is committed to utilizing the unspent CSR amount in the forthcoming financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The re-appointment of Mr. Anish Anil Mehta as Managing Director is for a period of 5 years with effect from March 2, 2025.
management_commitments.quote: approval of the members be and is hereby accorded to the re-appointment of Mr. Anish Anil Mehta (DIN-08560153), as Managing Director of the Company for a period of 5 (Five) years w.e.f. 02.03.2025

management_commitments.claim: The total amount borrowed by the Board shall not at any time exceed Rs. 50.00 crores.
management_commitments.quote: provided that the total amount so borrowed by the Board shall not at any time exceed of Rs. 50.00 crores (Rupees Fifty Crores only) or limits so prescribed under Section 180(1)(c), as may be amended from time to time, whichever is higher.

management_commitments.claim: The management expects to continue to deliver strong growth.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to be able to continue to deliver strong growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
